children.name: MongoDB Atlas - Alerts
children.description: The MongoDB Atlas - Alerts dashboard provides a high-level view of the number of alerts, open alerts, alert status, and metric alerts.
children.title: MongoDB Atlas - Alerts

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| count(id)

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| topk(1, updated) by id
| where status = "OPEN"
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| topk(1, updated) by id
| count by status
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| topk(1, updated) by id
| count by metricName
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| topk(1, updated) by id
| parse field=hostnameAndPort "*:*" as hostname, port
| count by metricName, hostname
| total _count as alert_count by hostname
| transpose row hostname, alert_count column metricName 
| sort by alert_count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","orgId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id, org_id, hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| topk(1, updated) by id
| if (isNull(org_id), format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2/%s#alerts", project_id), format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2#/org/%s/alerts/list", org_id)) as link
| tourl(link, id) as id
| count by id, updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName
| sort by updated
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| timeslice 15m
| count(id) by _timeslice
| sort +_timeslice
| outlier _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| timeslice 1h
| count(id) by _timeslice, status
| transpose row _timeslice column status

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| topk(1, updated) by id
| timeslice 1h
| count(id) by _timeslice, metricName
| transpose row _timeslice column metricName

children.title: MongoDB Atlas - Audit

panels.title: Audit Events Locations by Remote IP

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| count by remote_ip 
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = remote_ip

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| where result=18
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| where result=13
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| where result!=0
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, hostname
| transpose row _timeslice column hostname

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, atype
| transpose row _timeslice column atype

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| parse regex field=users "(?<json_blob>\{[^\}]+\})" multi
| json auto field=json_blob
| json field=json_blob "user", "db" as user, database_name
| count by user, atype
| if (atype matches "*create*" OR atype matches "*add*" OR atype matches "*grant*", "created", if (atype matches "*drop*" OR atype matches "*remove*" OR atype matches "*revoke*", "deleted", if (atype matches "*update*", "updated", "other"))) as audit_action_type
| count by user, audit_action_type
| total _count as activity_count by user
| sort by activity_count
| fields -activity_count
| transpose row user column audit_action_type

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name", "param.ns", "param.command" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name, namespace, command
| parse regex field=users "\"user\":\"(?<user>.*?)\"" multi nodrop
| parse field=namespace "*.*" as database, collection
| where atype matches "authCheck" and command matches /find|insert|delete|update|findandmodify/
| first(_messageTime) as latest_event_date group by atype, project_id, hostname, cluster_name, database, collection, user, command, local_ip, remote_ip
| sort by latest_event_date
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(latest_event_date)),"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as latest_event_date

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name", "param" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name, param
| json field=param "db", "ns" as database1, database2 nodrop
| parse field=database2 "*.*" as database2, collection nodrop
| if (isBlank(database1), database2, database1) as database
| where atype matches /create|add|grant|drop|remove|revoke|shutdown|rename|update|authenticate|authcheck/
| first(_messageTime) as latest_event_date group by atype, project_id, hostname, cluster_name,  database, collection, users, local_ip, remote_ip
| sort by latest_event_date
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(latest_event_date)),"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as latest_event_date

children.name: MongoDB Atlas - Events
children.description: The MongoDB Atlas - Events dashboard provides details on project and organization events in your environment.
children.title: MongoDB Atlas - Events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "replicaSetName", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port, replicaSetName, created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| count(id)

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "replicaSetName", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port, replicaSetName, created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| count(id)

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "replicaSetName", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port, replicaSetName, created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| where eventTypeName="MONGODB_USER_UPDATED"
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port, created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| count by remoteAddress 
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = remoteAddress

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "replicaSetName", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port, replicaSetName, created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| where !isNull(username)
| count by username,eventTypeName
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "replicaSetName", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port, replicaSetName, created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| count by eventTypeName
| if (isNull(eventTypeName), "Others", eventTypeName) as eventTypeName
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "replicaSetName", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port, replicaSetName, created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| where !isNull(hostname)
| count by created, eventTypeName,hostname
| topk(3, created) by hostname
| format("last_event_data: %s, eventTypeName: %s", created, eventTypeName) as host_event
| fields -_count,created,eventTypeName
| transpose row hostname column _rank

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname","clusterName", "port", "replicaSetName", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname,cluster_name, port, replicaSetName, created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| where !isNull(cluster_name)
| count by created, eventTypeName,cluster_name
| topk(3, created) by cluster_name
| format("last_event_data: %s, eventTypeName: %s", created, eventTypeName) as host_event
| fields -_count,created,eventTypeName
| transpose row cluster_name column _rank

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port,created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| where eventTypeName matches "*"
| if (isNull(org_id), format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2/%s#activity", project_id),format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2#/org/%s/activity/list", org_id)) as link
| tourl(link, id) as id
| count by created, id, org_id, project_id, eventTypeName, metricName, hostname, port, username, remoteAddress
| sort by created

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "replicaSetName", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port, replicaSetName, created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| where eventTypeName="CLUSTER_READY"
| count
